incarnation: Infernum: Nine Pits — Mercy Ash individual currently selected V2 portrait, original project canon2026
sourceLimits: Original internal Multiverse Breach character; selected HEROES_DB portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait are the same individual V2 source, not an external franchise reference.
One pixel-art view leaves tiny face markings, exact eye detail, hidden coat construction and chain attachment uncertain; preserve observed relationships and do not certify perfect1:1.
Source appears as an ash-skinned condemned guide; no chronological age is invented. New settings and poses are original compositions coherent with Infernum lore.
Old atlas shows a tan unarmed martial artist in light tank top/red sash/loose blue trousers; retained unchanged, not identity-qualified.
CG05 is a Nexus gameplay adaptation;CG09-11 Fan Art;CG12-15 explicit What If. Transformations preserve identifying hair/palette/equipment motif; source identity is not rewritten.
